summary: Checked all 60 dairy/protein-supplement/nut/fat/condiment/sweetener rows on A, C, D (no raw/cooked pairs). Milks (61/50/43/34), Greek yogurts (59/67/94, all plain), honey 304, peanut butter 598, whey 352/78, Fairlife x3 and Skippy ids all resolve and match labels. Wrong: Cottage cheese 2% id 328841 is a 404 (retired Foundation record) -> FNDDS 2705747 'Cheese, cottage, NFS' 82/11/4.31/2.3; Feta FNDDS protein 19.7 is ~39% above SR/labels (14.2) -> SR 173420; Parmesan FNDDS carries inflated by-difference carbs (8.4) and low protein (29.9) -> SR 170848 hard (392/35.75/3.22/25). Alias fixes: drop 'oikos triple zero' from plain nonfat Greek (it is flavored/sweetened); move 'nuts' from Almonds to Mixed nuts. Placeholders kept and flagged: Whey protein powder (SR generic; 'whey isolate' alias under-counts protein ~13%), Protein bar (FNDDS high-protein bar, real bars vary 300-450 kcal). Unsure: Greek 2% FNDDS 67 kcal vs SR 73 (both defensible, kept); whole-milk plain yogurt 78 vs SR-legacy 61 (kept FNDDS, matches labels). Added 8 verified rows: Cottage cheese 4%, Swiss, Provolone, Chia seeds, Pecans, Canola oil, Soy milk unsweetened, Nutella. 48 USDA requests used.
